fact: Sahal Tech officially opened its Sahal Tech Smart Innovation Hub, a professional training and innovation centre, on 23 May 2026, with no incubation cohort stated.

Orange Burkina Faso's CSR report says its Orange Digital Center acceleration programme, Damina incubation programme and related projects, backed by over FCFA 1.9 billion, supported 30 startups and trained 7,000 young people.
Orange Digital Center's Orange Fab accelerator in Ouagadougou selected 5 start-ups from 15 applicants (12 shortlisted) on 10 April 2025 for its nine-month fourth season, per Faso7.

Orange Digital Center Burkina Faso says five startups were selected for the cohort of the fifth Orange Fab acceleration season and will receive strategic and operational support over the coming months.
